arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re, datetime

path = "project_kickoff_meeting.ics"
content = open(path).read()

# Structural checks
assert content.count("BEGIN:VCALENDAR") == content.count("END:VCALENDAR") == 1
assert content.count("BEGIN:VEVENT") == content.count("END:VEVENT") == 1
assert content.count("BEGIN:VALARM") == content.count("END:VALARM") == 1

required = ["VERSION:2.0", "PRODID", "UID", "DTSTAMP", "DTSTART", "DTEND", "SUMMARY"]
for field in required:
    assert field in content, f"missing {field}"

# Date format checks
def parse_dt(s):
    return datetime.datetime.strptime(s, "%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

dtstart = parse_dt(re.search(r"DTSTART:(\d{8}T\d{6}Z)", content).group(1))
dtend   = parse_dt(re.search(r"DTEND:(\d{8}T\d{6}Z)", content).group(1))
dtstamp = parse_dt(re.search(r"DTSTAMP:(\d{8}T\d{6}Z)", content).group(1))

assert dtend > dtstart, "DTEND must be after DTSTART"
assert (dtend - dtstart) == datetime.timedelta(hours=2), "duration must be 2 hours"
assert dtstart.isoweekday() == 1, "must be a Monday"
assert dtstart.strftime("%H:%M") == "10:00", "must start at 10:00"
assert dtstamp <= datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(tzinfo=None), "DTSTAMP in future?"

print("Validation OK")
print(f"  Event : Project Kickoff Meeting")
print(f"  Start : {dtstart.isoformat()}Z ({dtstart.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"  End   : {dtend.isoformat()}Z")
print(f"  Duration: 2 hours")
EOF
